subject: Important Information Regarding Your Recent Purchase
body: Dear valued customer, We wanted to inform you that there was a slight delay in processing your recent order due to high demand. Rest assured, our team is working diligently to ensure your purchase reaches you promptly. We appreciate your understanding and patience during this time. Thank you for choosing our services. If you have any questions or concerns, feel free to reach out to our customer support team. Best regards, The Customer Service Team
